mapper.sql: SELECT drcc.drcc_id , drcc.drcc_dsc , drcc.drcc_calle , drcc.drcc_numeracion , drcc.drcc_referencia , drcc.drcc_imagen_perfil, drcc.drcc_latitud , drcc.drcc_longitud , drcc.drcc_flag_evidencia , clnt.clnt_id , clnt.clnt_nombre , cmna.cmna_id , cmna.cmna_dsc , prvs.prvs_id , prvs.prvs_dsc , rgns.rgns_id , rgns.rgns_dsc , pses.pses_id , pses.pses_dsc , sctr.sctr_id , sctr.sctr_dsc , znas.znas_id , znas.znas_dsc , tpdr.tpdr_id , tpdr.tpdr_dsc , estd.estd_id , estd.estd_dsc , ruta.ruta_id , ruta.ruta_dsc , null as cntc_id

FROM ${schema}direcciones as drcc INNER JOIN ${schema}clientes as clnt ON drcc.clnt_id = clnt.clnt_id INNER JOIN ${schema}comunas as cmna ON drcc.cmna_id = cmna.cmna_id INNER JOIN ${schema}provincias as prvs ON cmna.prvs_id = prvs.prvs_id INNER JOIN ${schema}regiones as rgns ON prvs.rgns_id = rgns.rgns_id INNER JOIN ${schema}paises as pses ON rgns.pses_id = pses.pses_id INNER JOIN ${schema}sectores as sctr ON drcc.sctr_id = sctr.sctr_id INNER JOIN ${schema}zonas as znas ON sctr.znas_id = znas.znas_id INNER JOIN ${schema}tipos_direcciones as tpdr ON drcc.tpdr_id = tpdr.tpdr_id INNER JOIN ${schema}estados as estd ON drcc.estd_id = estd.estd_id INNER JOIN ${schema}rutas as ruta ON drcc.ruta_id = ruta.ruta_id
mapper.select: SELECT ctdr.drcc_id , ctdr.clnt_id , ctdr.ctdr_rol , cntc.cntc_id , cntc.cntc_nombre , cntc.cntc_apellido_paterno, cntc.cntc_apellido_materno, cntc.cntc_imagen_perfil , cntc.cntc_email , cntc.cntc_fono_fijo , cntc.cntc_fono_movil , cntc.cntc_fecha_nacimiento, doid.doid_id , doid.doid_num , doid.doid_dv , tpdi.tpdi_id , tpdi.tpdi_nombre , tpdi.tpdi_dsc FROM ${schema}contatos_direcciones as ctdr INNER JOIN ${schema}contactos as cntc ON ctdr.cntc_id = cntc.cntc_id INNER JOIN ${schema}documentos_identificacion as doid ON cntc.doid_id = doid.doid_id INNER JOIN ${schema}tipos_documentos_identificacion as tpdi ON doid.tpdi_id = tpdi.tpdi_id WHERE ctdr.clnt_id = #{clienteId} AND ctdr.drcc_id = #{id} ORDER BY cntc.cntc_nombre

INSERT INTO ${schema}direcciones (clnt_id , drcc_dsc , drcc_calle , drcc_numeracion , drcc_referencia , cmna_id , sctr_id , tpdr_id , drcc_imagen_perfil, drcc_latitud , drcc_longitud , estd_id , drcc_flag_evidencia, ruta_id) VALUES (#{cliente.id} , #{descripcion} , #{calle} , #{numeracion} , #{referencia} , #{comuna.id} , #{sector.id}, #{tipoDireccion.id}, #{imagenPerfil} , #{latitud} , #{longitud} , #{estado.id} , #{flagEvidencia} , #{ruta.id}) returning drcc_id as id, drcc_dsc as descripcion, drcc_calle as calle, drcc_numeracion as numeracion, drcc_referencia as referencia
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ${schema}direcciones (clnt_id , drcc_dsc , drcc_calle , drcc_numeracion, drcc_referencia , cmna_id , sctr_id , tpdr_id , drcc_imagen_perfil , drcc_latitud, drcc_longitud , estd_id , drcc_flag_evidencia, ruta_id ) VALUES
(#{direccion.cliente.id} , #{direccion.descripcion}, #{direccion.calle} , #{direccion.numeracion} , #{direccion.referencia} , #{direccion.comuna.id} , #{direccion.sector.id} , #{direccion.tipoDireccion.id}, #{direccion.imagenPerfil} , #{direccion.latitud} , #{direccion.longitud} , #{direccion.estado.id} , #{direccion.flagEvidencia}, #{direccion.ruta.id} )
